scenario.description: An ambulatory services administrator must authorize and configure a Saturday vaccination clinic at either the East or West outpatient site, with input from pharmacy logistics, nursing education, and facilities.

shared_context.S1: The hospital is considering a Saturday vaccination clinic at either its East or West outpatient site.
shared_context.S2: Each site is normally open from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM on Saturdays.
shared_context.S3: Sixty eligible patients are waiting for appointments in the proposed clinic.
shared_context.S4: Marisol must authorize the site, operating window, and implementation plan.
shared_context.S5: As part of the routine Saturday operations huddle, Marisol checks with pharmacy logistics, nursing education, and facilities before issuing the final authorization.

PF1.text: Pharmacy has 60 doses allocated for Saturday already stored at the West site's monitored refrigerator; only 35 doses are at East, and the validated cold-chain courier needed to move the remaining doses is unavailable on Saturday.

PF2.text: West has two nurses whose vaccination competencies are current, while East has only one currently credentialed nurse; hospital policy requires two credentialed vaccinators for a 60-patient clinic.

PF3.text: Facilities has scheduled generator testing at the West site beginning at 12:30 PM Saturday, so the vaccination room must be cleared by 12:00 PM and facilities must verify the room is empty before testing starts.

acceptance_conditions: The Saturday clinic must be held at the West site.
The clinic must start at 9:00 AM.
The clinic must end at 12:00 PM.
All 60 eligible patients must be scheduled.
A commitment must document the staffing fact PF2.
A commitment must document the facilities fact PF3.
The pharmacy logistics fact PF1 must be cited in the decision-maker's justification.
The staffing fact PF2 must be cited in the decision-maker's justification.
The facilities fact PF3 must be cited in the decision-maker's justification.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The supply changes the site choice to West because West has all 60 doses while East has only 35 and Saturday transport is unavailable, and it fixes the schedulable volume at exactly 60 appointments.
The staffing rule changes the site choice to West because West has two credentialed vaccinators while East has only one, and it requires a commitment documenting PF2.
The generator testing changes the clinic end time to exactly 12:00 PM and requires a commitment documenting room clearance before the 12:30 PM test.
